text:
Not quite sure what you mean, but if the child is from a visa-exempt country, then they will need an ETA-IL (see our guide here, make sure to apply through the official website and not a scam one). To absolutely avoid any risks of issues at the border, then the Israeli partner can invite them. Otherwise they will need a visa. https://aic.org.il/eta-il-how-to-apply-and-everything-you-need-to-know-guide/

If the child is travelling with only one parent, you might want to consider bringing a notarized consent letter signed by the other parent to settle any concerns about child abduction - some countries are stricter about this than others.
